description: Meet Dana | Acerca de Dana Dana Levenberg was first elected to represent the 95th Assembly District of New York in 2022. The district is composed of communities in northern Westchester and western Putnam counties, encompassing the towns of Ossining, Cortlandt, Philipstown and their villages; the City of Peekskill; and portions of Yorktown.
